description: This PHP source file defines the Map controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It manages dashboard map configuration, rendering, and data retrieval functions, including handling settings, permissions, and generating JSON data for map visualization.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Controller class for managing the dashboard map extension, including displaying settings, saving configurations, rendering the dashboard view, and providing map data in JSON format.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets up breadcrumbs, prepares view data, and renders the dashboard map configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard map settings after permission validation; returns JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Loads language and renders the map info view for dashboard display.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Retrieves total orders by country, formats results as JSON, and outputs the map data.
